summary: Acorn Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on August 17, 2026 it exchanged 100 Series A preferred shares of OMX Holdings, Inc. held by Walter Czarnecki, former CEO of subsidiary OmniMetrix, for 25,096 newly-issued common shares, representing approximately 1% of Acorn's outstanding shares. This eliminated the minority preferred interest, leaving Acorn owning 100% of OMX. No premium, price, or valuation was disclosed. The transaction likely simplifies ownership of OmniMetrix. What to watch: potential future consolidation or strategic actions involving OmniMetrix, with no risk-arb angle.
